title: Longwise Server
description: A non whitelisted server that has anarchy creative, Create Mod, and a normal SMP.
body: A non whitelisted server that has anarchy creative, Create Mod, and a normal SMP (named Portal SMP). There is also a Discord server which is joinable at https://discord.gg/SUspvQ7bXA. That Discord server is only for the Portal SMP. If you have any questions, join the Discord server or email me at admin@longwise.net. You can also check out the website at https://longwise.net.
